This book has a companion website called Compass. It is a place to practice what the book teaches about artificial intelligence (AI): to try the quizzes, step through the diagrams, follow current tool instructions for the labs, and collect your work. The book is complete without it. Compass is there if you want more practice or more up-to-date detail than a printed page can hold.

## The Rule That Comes First {.unnumbered}

If you are a student at The University of Texas at Dallas (UTD), Compass is **optional, free and ungraded**. Nothing you do in Compass counts toward your course grade, and nothing you do in the course is sent to Compass. Your grades and submissions stay in the university's eLearning system. Everything required for the course is in this book or on eLearning, so you lose nothing graded by never opening Compass.

## What Compass Offers {.unnumbered}

As planned at the time of writing (October 2026), Compass mirrors the book chapter by chapter:

- **Interactive diagrams.** The signature diagrams, revealed step by step. A figure in the book and its interactive version in Compass share the same number.
- **Practice with feedback.** The Warm-up and Check Yourself questions, and Review Questions A as quizzes that explain each answer.
- **Lab pages.** The book describes each lab without naming buttons or menus, because they change too often. Compass keeps the current step-by-step instructions for today's tools, dated and updated, plus the data files the labs use.
- **Templates and examples.** Templates for the Application Assignments and the AI Use Declaration, with sample submissions.
- **A portfolio space** for collecting and exporting your artifacts.
- **Later in the term:** a tutor-mode assistant that gives hints rather than answers, following the evidence in Chapter 7. It will open only after its privacy design has been reviewed.

The first release, planned for January 8, 2027, covers Part I: the chapter pages, the quizzes and lab pages for Chapters 1–4, and interactive versions of three signature diagrams. Later chapters follow during the term.

## Finding Your Way In {.unnumbered}

Throughout the book, a short link and a QR (quick response) code point from a chapter, lab or figure to its page in Compass. Scan the code with a phone, or type the short link.

Compass is at **optiwisdom.com**.

## What Works Without an Account {.unnumbered}

The plan is that you can read the chapter pages, use the interactive diagrams and try the Warm-up and Check Yourself quizzes without signing up. A free account adds the parts that need to remember you: your quiz history and personal review queue, the lab checkpoints, the assignment templates, the portfolio space and, later, the tutor-mode assistant.

Before you create an account, read Compass's own data-handling page: it states what an account stores, how long it keeps it and whether anything you type is used to train a model. Apply the same check you learn in Chapter 12 to any tool, including this one.

## The Certificate Path {.unnumbered}

Compass also leads to an optional certificate at two levels: **AI for All Certified — Foundations** and **AI for All Certified — Practitioner**. OptiWisdom, the company that builds Compass, issues the certificate. It is not UTD credit, it does not use UTD's name or logo, and it has nothing to do with your course grade. Appendix D describes the certification exam's blueprint and includes a full-length practice exam.

Exam dates, delivery and any fee are announced in Compass. None of it is required for the course.

## A Disclosure {.unnumbered}

Compass is built by OptiWisdom. I am a founder of OptiWisdom, which develops software for businesses, including AI tools. That is a commercial interest, and you should weigh what I say about Compass with it in mind. It is also why the rule above is firm: for UTD students, Compass stays optional, free and ungraded, and student data does not move between the course and Compass. The book's open license is not changed by Compass; a separate license lets Compass use the material. "How This Book Was Written" declares the interest in full.
